theorems.name: Submission.dgc_periodic_maximal
theorems.statement: ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X), IsFiniteMeasure μ → ∀ p : X → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι, Measurable p → ∀ (g₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (β : ℝ), 0 < β → volume {g : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι | dist g g₀ < 1 / 4 ∧ ∃ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ σ < 1 / 4 ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (β * σ ^ Fintype.card ι) * μ univ < μ {x | ∃ z : ι → ℤ, ∑ i, (p x i - g i - z i) ^ 2 < σ ^ 2}} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (10 ^ Fintype.card ι / β)
